lines.en: I have left Dunder Mifflin after many record-breaking years.
And I am officially on the job market.
For your convenience, I've broken it down into three parts.
I am ready to face any challenges
that might be foolish enough to face me.
There's nothing on my horizon except everything.
I got this job to make some money
while I continue my employment search.
It's fine for the time being.
